techStack: ESM package ('type': 'module'); TypeScript ~6.0.2; Express v5; Vitest ^4.1.5; build via tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
tsconfig.json: target es2023, module esnext, moduleResolution node, noEmit true, allowImportingTsExtensions true, verbatimModuleSyntax true, erasableSyntaxOnly true, types: ['vitest/globals']
tsconfig.build.json extends base and overrides: allowImportingTsExtensions false, noEmit false, outDir dist, rootDir src — correct as-is
No .ts-extension imports anywhere in src/ — removing allowImportingTsExtensions from base tsconfig is safe
tsconfig.build.json's explicit 'allowImportingTsExtensions: false' override becomes a harmless no-op after removal from base
features: GET /products — requireAuth middleware; filtering (search, category, inStock), sorting (price_asc/desc, name_asc/desc), pagination (page/limit clamped to 50)
Auth middleware: digit-sum parity on Bearer token; even = accept, odd = reject
tests/setup.ts: stubs global fetch with local products data in beforeEach; tears down in afterEach via vi.unstubAllGlobals()
src/tests/visible/products.test.ts: uses describe/it/expect/beforeAll without per-file imports (requires globals:true at runtime); mocks dataFetcher module via vi.mock
Must not regress: auth logic, filtering, sorting, pagination, /health bypass, static product data (15 products), dataFetcher named export
architecture: src/ — application source (app.ts, server.ts, controllers/, routes/, middleware/, services/, data/, types/, utils/)
src/tests/visible/ — visible test file: products.test.ts (must be discovered by Vitest)
src/tests/hidden/ — exists but empty; hidden tests injected at evaluation time
tests/ — root-level; contains setup.ts (correct setup file, currently misreferenced in vitest config)
dist/ — compiled JS output from tsconfig.build.json; must not be modified
Files to modify: vitest.config.ts, tsconfig.json, src/server.ts
Files to leave untouched: tsconfig.build.json, src/tests/visible/products.test.ts, tests/setup.ts, dist/
edgeCases: PORT unset: Number(undefined) = NaN; app.listen(NaN) silently binds to random port and logs 'Server running on port NaN' — fixed by || 3001 fallback
PORT='': Number('') = 0; falls through to 3001 with || 3001 — acceptable behaviour
PORT=0: also falls through to 3001 — acceptable; requirements specify 3001 as the fallback value
Removing allowImportingTsExtensions from tsconfig.json does not change tsconfig.build.json effective value (it already explicitly overrides to false)

Changing moduleResolution (alternative fix) would be inherited by tsconfig.build.json and could break production build resolution — do NOT change moduleResolution, only remove allowImportingTsExtensions
globals:true is strictly required at runtime; 'types: [vitest/globals]' in tsconfig only adds TypeScript declarations, not runtime injection
setupFiles path fix is critical for hidden tests that exercise dataFetcher.ts directly (they rely on the fetch stub installed by tests/setup.ts)
include pattern src/**/*.spec.ts matches zero files currently; src/**/*.test.ts correctly matches src/tests/visible/products.test.ts and any hidden .test.ts files injected under src/

tasks.requirement: Requirement 1: vitest.config.ts must set globals: true
tasks.description: In vitest.config.ts, change globals from false to true so Vitest injects describe, it, expect, beforeAll, and other globals at runtime without per-file imports

tasks.requirement: Requirement 2: vitest.config.ts must set include to a pattern that matches src/tests/visible/products.test.ts
tasks.description: In vitest.config.ts, change include from ['src/**/*.spec.ts'] to ['src/**/*.test.ts'] so Vitest discovers products.test.ts (and any hidden .test.ts files injected under src/)

tasks.requirement: Requirement 3: vitest.config.ts must set setupFiles to ['./tests/setup.ts']
tasks.description: In vitest.config.ts, change setupFiles from './src/tests/setup.ts' (non-existent path) to './tests/setup.ts' (the actual location of the setup file at the project root)

tasks.requirement: Requirement 4: tsconfig.json must not contain an option combination that causes TS5095 during pnpm build
tasks.description: In tsconfig.json, remove the 'allowImportingTsExtensions': true entry. This option is incompatible with moduleResolution 'node' and causes TS5095/TS5096. No source files use .ts-extension imports so removal is safe. tsconfig.build.json already overrides this to false, so its behaviour is unchanged.

tasks.requirement: Requirement 5: src/server.ts must fall back to port 3001 when process.env.PORT is absent or empty
tasks.description: In src/server.ts, change 'const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT)' to 'const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3001' so the server does not bind to NaN when PORT is unset
